messages.subject: For Warwick Brady | Global aviation services, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market growth
messages.body:
Dear Swissport Group Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Warwick Brady, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Swissport's global growth across ground handling, cargo and airport services requires disciplined alignment across aviation authorities, airport operators, governments and strategic partners. That interface closely matches my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and emerging-market stakeholder strategy might support Swissport's global priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Swissport International.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
